Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by filtering molecule_dictionary for CHEMBL221959 and joining molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to include all salts. Join compound_records on molregno, then activities on record_id, then docs on doc_id, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter activities for standard_type IC50 and standard_units nM. Filter target_dictionary for chembl_id CHEMBL2971. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Do not limit rows.
